intent: T9 acceleration is additive. It may not consume, defer, weaken or redefine any existing VECTOR delivery commitment.
hardRules: Friday FORGE remains the first protected release/proof milestone.
No existing capability may be removed, deferred or weakened to make a T9 deadline.
No safety, security, payroll, tenant, audit, approval, provenance or rollback gate may be relaxed for schedule.
No UI redesign or architecture rewrite is allowed unless required to repair a proven critical defect.
T9 work must extend canonical owners and shared services; parallel replacement stacks are prohibited.
A blocked lane must route around the blocker without stealing capacity from unrelated critical lanes.
Simulation may accelerate discovery but never substitutes for exact-candidate proof.
Every deadline claim must distinguish built, integrated, hosted-proven and production-proven states.

required: exact FORGE candidate deployable with immutable release identity
proof receipt bound to exact source/image identity
T9 control spine enforced across every consequential mutation domain
domain proof against Sunday T9 exit contract

laneIsolation.convergenceRule: Only merge parallel work when exact-candidate regression evidence shows no harm to protected milestones.

requiredResponse: classify blocker as product, proof, provider, data, authority or environment
preserve last known good release identity
never weaken a guard to unblock
record evidence and permanent regression when resolved

sundayAcceptanceRule: T9 is not allowed to be declared complete if any protected non-T9 commitment is late because T9 work displaced it.
